now.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
now.text: Ousted from Oscorp, he frees Electro from Ravencroft to break into the company. Harry injects the spider venom, dons Oscorp armor and becomes the Green Goblin.

proposed.text: Ousted from Oscorp, he frees Electro from Ravencroft to break into the company. Harry forces Menken to inject him with the spider venom, dons Oscorp armor and becomes the Green Goblin.

changes.evidence: In The Amazing Spider-Man 2, Harry does not inject himself: back at Oscorp he forces Donald Menken to inject him with the spider venom (Wikipedia plot: 'Harry forces Menken to inject him with venom from genetically altered spiders'; Marvel Database: 'Menken ... was forced to inject Harry with the spider venom').
